principles: Appropriate volume for each muscle group

BEGINNER.goal: Learn proper technique, improve mobility, and build a strength foundation.

INTERMEDIATE.goal: Build muscle, improve work capacity, and increase training volume.

ADVANCED.goal: Maximise strength and hypertrophy through progressive overload.

meta.activeRecoveryGuidance: 20-30 min light cardio (walk, bike, swim) plus mobility/stretching. No heavy lifting.

programs.description: A 4-day Full Gym (Weights & Machines) split — Legs, Chest, Back, Arms. Learn proper technique, improve mobility, and build a strength foundation. 2–3 sets x 12 reps, 60–90s rest. Saturday is active recovery, Wednesday and Sunday is rest.

A 5-day Full Gym (Weights & Machines) split — Legs, Chest, Back, Arms, Shoulders. Build muscle, improve work capacity, and increase training volume. 3 sets, pyramid reps 15→12→10, 60–90s rest. Saturday is active recovery, Sunday is rest.

A 5-day Full Gym (Weights & Machines) split — Legs, Chest, Back, Arms, Shoulders. Maximise strength and hypertrophy through progressive overload. 4 sets, pyramid reps 15→12→10→5, 60–90s rest. Saturday is active recovery, Sunday is rest.
